import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = scanner.nextLong();
        long y = scanner.nextLong();
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        
        double minDiff = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        long ansA = 0, ansB = 0;
        
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            long a = x * i / y;
            double diff1 = Math.abs((double) x / y - (double) a / i);
            if (diff1 < minDiff) {
                minDiff = diff1;
                ansA = a;
                ansB = i;
            }
            a++;
            double diff2 = Math.abs((double) x / y - (double) a / i);
            if (diff2 < minDiff) {
                minDiff = diff2;
                ansA = a;
                ansB = i;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(ansA + "/" + ansB);
    }
}
